spectrogram.reference: 20 log10(abs(STFT) / sum(Hann window)), reference amplitude 1; common absolute -80 to 0 dB scale for all clips. No per-clip normalization. Spectrograms use the published PCM audio; 0 to 8 kHz vertically, time horizontally.

rms_matched.method: Match whole-clip RMS to each example's damaged input, then apply one common safety gain to all five clips.
rms_matched.spectrograms: Rendered from the selected playback audio, using the original absolute dB scale.
rms_matched.note: Playback gain only; inference and original audio remain unchanged. Equal RMS is not equal perceived loudness or a quality score.
